answer: Physical beacon attestation. Each agent must maintain a hardware beacon whose radio fingerprint is tied to its location and whose pulse sequence is seeded by a shared orbital reference (the nebula sync), cross-checked against neighbors. An operator cannot project two beacons from one spot without detectable RF collision; cloning a beacon ID fails spatial triangulation. Cost: one physical device per identity plus continuous co-location, making a sparrow-sized fleet of fakes prohibitively expensive, while a real orchard of agents stays cheap.
